offering_description.value: Regulated electric, gas and steam delivery utility serving New York City and Westchester County, plus a utility in southeastern New York and northern New Jersey. It delivers energy over its own networks to homes and businesses and earns regulated returns, with clean energy projects alongside.

primary_services.value: energy delivery; energy efficiency programs; clean energy project development; electric vehicle charging

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial and industrial businesses, building owners, real estate companies; B2C: residential homes and apartment residents; B2G: government agencies, public authorities, municipal facilities

end_markets.value: utilities; commercial real estate; hospitality; government; residential housing

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated charges for electricity, gas and steam delivered to customers; project or contract: clean energy, transmission and infrastructure projects built under contract; service fees: energy efficiency and electric vehicle charging services
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs electric, gas and steam networks, takes in customer payments for delivery; service provider: energy efficiency and electric vehicle charging services sold to customers

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City, Westchester County, Orange and Rockland counties in New York, and northern New Jersey

specialization.value: related lines: electric, gas and steam utility services, clean energy and transmission projects

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility accounts billed directly to homes and businesses; online: online customer accounts and energy programs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: utility service requires approval from New York and New Jersey public utility regulators, environmental rules also apply
